title: p-Spin Glass Network Efficient Single-Batch Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern sequence models heavily rely on massive memory footprints and large-batch stochastic optimization, barriers that restrict sample efficiency and continual learning. We introduce the $p$-Spin Glass Network, a novel architecture that overcomes these limitations, structurally manages optimization variance and yields four noticeable capabilities: 1. It enforces memory efficiency: native ternary quantization compresses internal parameters by $8\times$, while exact implicit gradients strictly bound activation memory to $\mathcal{O}(B \cdot T \cdot D)$. 2. it demonstrates sample efficiency, matching the asymptotic performance of a Transformer baseline while utilizing $8\times$ fewer training sequences. 3. Method enables single-batch stability and smooth, monotonic convergence at a stochastic micro-batch size of $1$. 4. translated_title: p-自旋玻璃网络：高效单批次持续学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14774v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代序列模型严重依赖庞大的内存占用和大批量随机优化，这些障碍限制了样本效率和持续学习。我们引入了p-自旋玻璃网络，一种新颖的架构，克服了这些限制，结构性地管理优化方差，并展现出四个显著能力：1. 它强制实现内存效率：原生三值量化将内部参数压缩8倍，而精确隐式梯度严格将激活内存限制在O(B · T · D)。2. 它展示了样本效率，在利用8倍更少的训练序列时，匹配Transformer基线的渐近性能。3. 该方法实现了单批次稳定性，并在随机微批次大小为1时实现平滑、单调收敛。4. 最后，这种稳定性被证明是模态无关的，在离散子词和连续域中均保持稳健的时间信用分配。
tldr: 本文提出p-自旋玻璃网络，通过结构化的优化方差管理和三值量化，实现了8倍内存压缩和8倍样本效率提升，支持单批次稳定训练，并跨模态保持持续学习能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the p-Spin Glass Network, which achieves 8x memory compression and 8x sample efficiency via structured variance management and ternary quantization, enabling stable single-batch training and modality-agnostic continual learning.
